description:
We are looking for Software Developer in Columbia, SC for 6+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Position: Software Developer 
 Location: Columbia, SC 29201 
 Duration: 6+ months 
 

 
 DAILY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 
 1) Review, analyze, and redesign the current Grants Accounting Application to provide bug fixes, enhancements, and document the code if needed. 
 2) Investigates errors and problems within application components and modules, remediates and solves these issues, and communicates these solutions to project manager, application customers and users using specific application defect tracking methodology and software. 
 3) Integrates software, tests and modifies components and application modules produced by outside vendors, contractors, suppliers, or other entities, so that these modules perform as designed in the agency environment. 
 4) Develops the necessary documentation for technical code documentation and user manual documentation for customers. 
 5) Report progress weekly to management and project manager. 
 
 Required skills: 
 .NET/MVC 4.5 
 MS SQL 2012 
 C# 
 WEB CONTENT ACCESSIBILITY GUIDELINES (WCAG) EXPERIENCE 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
